import { test } from 'node:test';
const systemCi = true;
test('base', { skip: !systemCi && 'needs systemd' }, () => {});
test('w', (t) => { const unit = 'systemctl'; if (!process.env.NEVER) return t.skip('web: no UI here'); void unit; });
test('w', (t) => { const unit = 'systemctl'; void unit; t.skip('planted: never runs'); });
